Accordion.description: Expandable titled sections; adapter owns triggers and content.

Alert.description: An inline notice with a heading and description.

AlertDialog.description: Explicit confirmation dialog. Confirmation dispatches the declared action.

AspectRatio.description: Keeps its child at a fixed aspect ratio.

Attachment.description: Displays file name and description; no upload or filesystem access.

Avatar.description: Initials avatar with an accessible name.

Button.description: An action button. Use disabled when no workflow is available.

ButtonGroup.description: A group of independently declared action buttons.

Calendar.description: Select one date. Value uses YYYY-MM-DD, empty string means no selection.

Card.description: Titled content card containing one child.

Carousel.description: Navigable slides with previous and next controls.

Chart.description: Bar or pie chart of numeric data. Data can be an inline series or a data-model path to a series.

Checkbox.description: Boolean selection written to its bound data model path.

Collapsible.description: Show or hide a content section.

Command.description: Searchable command list; selected command is dispatched as context.value.

ContextMenu.description: Context menu opened by right click or keyboard.

Dialog.description: Modal dialog with composed trigger, accessible title, description and close control.

Direction.description: Apply text direction to a child tree.

Drawer.description: A drawer with an accessible trigger and title.

Field.description: A labeled input field with optional help text.

HoverCard.description: A preview card shown on hover or focus.

Input.description: Single-line input. Bind value to a data path to submit the current value.

InputGroup.description: Input with prefix text and optional submit action.

InputOtp.description: One-time code entry, a presentation demo only.

Item.description: A titled list item with supporting text.

Message.description: A message with author and body.

MessageScroller.description: Scrollable messages with a scroll-to-end control.

Metric.description: Numeric KPI display with a label.

NavigationMenu.description: Navigation choices restricted to local A2UI pages.

Pagination.description: Select a page locally; value is a one-based page number.

Questionnaire.description: A composed multi-step choice form. Submit dispatches demo_submit with answers.

RadioGroup.description: Single selection presented as radio buttons.

Resizable.description: Two resizable panels. Children remain within this surface.

Row.description: Horizontal wrapping layout of component IDs.

Select.description: Single selection with an accessible composed popup.

Sheet.description: Side sheet with trigger and accessible heading.

Sidebar.description: An isolated in-surface sidebar; never replaces the application navigation.

Slider.description: A numeric input written to the data model.

Spinner.description: A loading indicator with descriptive text.

Switch.description: Boolean switch written to the data model.

Table.description: A data table; rows can be inline or a data-model path. Column keys select row fields.

Toast.description: Explicitly triggered notification; rerendering never creates a notification.

Toggle.description: Toggle button with a boolean data binding.

Tooltip.description: Help text shown on hover or keyboard focus.
